Package com.example.campuseventdiscoverysystem.activities

Class SessionManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.campuseventdiscoverysystem.activities.SessionManager
public class SessionManager extends Object
SessionManager — Singleton Production-level inactivity session timeout: • Warn user at 15 minutes of inactivity (via BaseSessionActivity dialog) • Hard auto-logout at 20 minutes of inactivity • Timer resets on every user interaction (tap, scroll, key press) • Persistent across app restarts via SharedPreferences Architecture: SessionManager stores the last-active timestamp in SharedPreferences. BaseSessionActivity checks it in onResume() and onUserInteraction(). A background Handler fires the warning/logout callbacks. Usage (all automatic via BaseSessionActivity — no manual calls needed): SessionManager.getInstance(context).startSession() → call on login success SessionManager.getInstance(context).resetIdleTimer() → call on user interaction SessionManager.getInstance(context).isSessionValid() → true if invalid input: '<' 20 min idle SessionManager.getInstance(context).isWarningDue() → true if >= 15 min idle SessionManager.getInstance(context).logout() → clear + sign out
